# transmux test fixtures

Independent-oracle fixtures for the crypto fixes (audit r05 W1/W2/W7) are indexed in [`ORACLES.md`](ORACLES.md):
`sample_aes_h264/`, `sample_aes_eac3/`, `cenc_frag_layouts/`, each with a `gen.sh` and a README recording tool versions
and evidence. (`sample_aes/` holds the older E-AC-3 5.1 fixture used by a src unit test.)
